# Codexnovas

> Codexnovas is a next-generation technology company specializing in high-performance web development, mobile application engineering, custom artificial intelligence solutions, and scalable enterprise software architecture.

## Company Profile
- **Official Name**: Codexnovas
- **Legal Name**: Codexnovas
- **Category**: Technology Company & AI Innovations
- **Official Website**: https://codexnovas.in
- **Tagline**: Next-Gen Tech Company | Web, App & AI Engineering

## Core Technology Capabilities
- **Web Engineering**: High-speed, responsive, enterprise-grade web applications built with Next.js, React, and modern UI frameworks.
- **Mobile Software Development**: Cross-platform native mobile applications built using Flutter and React Native.
- **AI & Intelligent Automation**: Enterprise machine learning, custom LLM integration, AI chatbots, and intelligent workflow automation.
- **Enterprise Software Systems**: Cloud architecture, robust backend APIs (Spring Boot, Node.js), microservices, and database design.
